can

10 Endangered Fish Species
Atlantic Bluefin Tuna
– Overfishing and high demand in sushi markets
European Eel
– Barriers like dams and overharvesting
Devils Hole Pupfish
– Extremely limited habitat (one small desert pool)
Mekong Giant Catfish
– Overfishing and dam construction
Chinese Paddlefish
– Likely extinct due to overfishing and habitat loss
Beluga Sturgeon
– Overharvested for caviar
Smalltooth Sawfish
– Bycatch and habitat destruction
Red Handfish
– Very limited range and habitat degradation
Giant Sea Bass
– Historical overfishing
Humphead (Napoleon) Wrasse
– Targeted for live reef fish trade
